text: Computer science and technology is based on mathematics, electronics, information theory, etc., and focuses on core issues such as the structure of computer systems, algorithms, the interaction between software and hardware, and data processing. Its development began in the mid-20th century. With the birth of the first electronic computer (ENIAC), the discipline gradually took shape and rapidly evolved: from the era of large mainframes, to the widespread use of personal computers, and then to the current era of the Internet, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence, computer science and technology has always led technological revolutions and industrial transformations. The core objective of this discipline is to address the technical issues in the acquisition, storage, processing, transmission and application of information. It combines theoretical depth with engineering practicality and integrates with multiple disciplines such as mathematics, electronic engineering, automation, and biology, giving rise to emerging fields like artificial intelligence, blockchain, and quantum computing.
